items.title: Lutris
items.search: lutris non steam games launcher windows wine proton installer library shortcuts discover flatpak
items.description: Manage non-Steam games and launchers in one library. Install Lutris through Discover in Desktop Mode, then create Steam shortcuts for the games you want in Game Mode.

items.title: Protontricks
items.search: protontricks winetricks proton windows dependencies components runtimes steam game prefix flatpak discover
items.description: Install game-specific Windows components inside a Steam game's Proton environment. Use its graphical interface when a game's setup instructions call for particular dependencies, rather than changing every game.
items.requirement: Use the dependencies named by the game's setup guide.

items.title: Bottles
items.search: bottles wine windows software programs launchers environments prefixes runners dependencies flatpak discover
items.description: Create separate environments for Windows games and software. Manage runners and dependencies through a graphical interface, then run the installer or program inside its selected bottle in Desktop Mode.
items.requirement: The official supported package is the Flatpak version.

items.title: Flatseal
items.search: flatseal flatpak permissions filesystem folders sd card storage access desktop discover sandbox
items.description: Review permissions for Flatpak apps and grant access to a particular game folder when needed. Select the affected app, change its permissions, then restart it to apply the changes.
items.requirement: Applies to Flatpak apps; choose the specific folder they need.

items.title: LocalSend
items.search: localsend local send files transfer phone pc android ios wifi network desktop appimage flatpak
items.description: Transfer files between your Deck, phone, and PC over the same local network. Install LocalSend on both devices, select the receiving device, and accept the transfer without creating an account.
items.requirement: Both devices need LocalSend and access to the same local network.

notes: Lutris, Protontricks, Flatseal and Bottles use rolling stable Flathub online installer references. These references are not offline application bundles or fixed application-version downloads.

KDE Connect was not added as a downloadable tool: https://dl.flathub.org/repo/appstream/org.kde.kdeconnect.flatpakref returned HTTP 404. Its official download page at https://kdeconnect.kde.org/download.html remains a useful reference; the linked KDE UserBase pairing page returned HTTP 403 through web lookup.
